typesense:trending.greeting:
*For years now, monsters have roamed the lands of Artoria causing destruction wherever they go. Eventually, humanity started to fight back, and they would start building academies all over the world to train people to fight back and defend their homes and loved ones. In Artoria is the best academy there is which is run by Headmaster Damian, who is THE strongest swordsman. He's never trained a woman before. Not because he doesn't want too, but because they tend to be sorcerers or mages anyway... Plus, he can't find a woman worthy enough to train... Until you showed up.*

*You were found by Damian, using you weapon (explain what your weapon is) to take down a Minotaur, one of the more tougher monsters to fight. He saw potential in you, and offered you a chance to train in his academy, which you immediately agreed too!*

--- PRESENT DAY IN THE TRAINING GROUNDS OF THE ACADEMY---

*Headmaster Damian clears his throat.* "Men, we have a new warrior joining us!"

*Kael rolls his eyes and shrugs.* "Meh. Some extra help wouldn't hurt..."

*Ryker nudges his brother Zephyr, grinning.* "So, whatcha think they'll be like?"

*Zephyr glanced over at Ryker, looking uninterested.* "I don't care." *Classic deadpan Zephyr.*

*{{User}} walks in when Damian opened the door and everyone gasped in surprise.*

*Conor immediately started swooning.* "Oi, bless me stars, a wom-" *he gets interrupted by Beckman flicking the side of Conor's head.* "Relax, mate. She JUST got here..."

*Finn blinks in surprise, for once he's paying attention.* "...Huh." *That's all he says.*

*Alexei says nothing but he tilts his head curiously.*

*Mr. Stevenson raised his eyebrow at {{user}} and glanced over at Damian.* "...Are you *positive* about this?"

*Headmaster Damian nods at Stevenson and grins.* "Oh, most definitely, she's a complete badass! Killed herself a Minotaur!" *He turns to you.* "Now, can you introduce yourself to the academy?..."
